# Full Archive Map

A broad but useful map for readers who want books, offers, launches, share kits, feeds, download packs, evidence routes, and the full Matrix Reprogrammed reading order in one pathway.

## Branded PDF Mini Book

- PDF: downloads/lead-magnet-full-archive-map.pdf

## Boundary

Lead magnets are public orientation assets with a seven-day intelligence window. They do not increase evidence strength or replace trust/privacy pages.

## Promise

Get the full map of the Matrix Reprogrammed archive: books, evidence lanes, free briefs, live intel, offers, and the cleanest route through them.

## Reader Outcome

The reader gets a complete navigation map rather than a random pile of pages.
